**How We Think About Content & Campaigns**

**This is not a volume role.** Success is not measured by how much content is produced, but by how deeply it resonates with the CXOs and functional heads of large telecom and tower companies. Every asset starts from a real pain point these leaders face, positions Infozech's solutions as the answer, and is engineered — in format and distribution — to reach influential decision-makers and convert their attention into enquiries and demand. Quality of resonance and distribution matter more than quantity.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Start from the real pain points of CXOs and functional heads of towercos and telecom operators, and craft narratives that position Infozech's solutions and capabilities as the answer.

**3. AEO & SEO (AI-Linked Search Visibility)**

* AEO: structure and format content so Infozech surfaces in AI-generated answers, generative search, snippets, and LLM responses — via question-led formats, structured data, and entity clarity.
* SEO: keyword research, on-page and meta-tag optimization, technical hygiene, and Google Business Profile (GMB) ratings and listings.
* Render every asset for easier, better distribution — the right format, structure, and metadata so it travels well to the people who matter.

**4. Campaigns & Demand Generation**

* Build sharply targeted, pain-point-led campaigns aimed at CXOs and functional heads — not broad-reach noise, but narratives that name a real problem and position Infozech as the solution.
* Engineer how each asset is rendered and distributed so it reaches influential people in the format most likely to land — and track how it converts into enquiries and qualified demand.
* Use automation to curate and manage the campaign lifecycle — audience building, sequencing, delivery, follow-up — so targeting and timing stay precise at scale.

BBA, B.Tech, MBA, or a degree in Journalism, English, Communication, or an equivalent field. 3 years in B2B marketing, preferably in technology, SaaS, or telecom.

Track and report SEO KPIs (rankings, CTR, organic traffic, conversions) using GA4, Search Console, and SEO tools.

Monitor competitors, identify SEO gaps, and propose innovative optimization opportunities.

Work cross\-functionally with content writers, developers, and marketing managers to implement SEO best practices.

minimum 6 years of SEO experience with at least 2 years focused on B2B products or services.

Deep understanding of B2B marketing funnels, long sales cycles, and decision\-maker targeting.

Proficient in SEO tools: Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, GA4\.

Familiar with technical concepts: site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, robots.txt, sitemap.xml.

Strong communication and collaboration skills to influence across teams.
